name: Sapporo International Art Festival
known: Director team for 2027: Ogawa Hideaki (Artistic Director), Hosokawa Asami (Festival Director), Urushi Takahiro (School Director) and Maruta Tomoaki (Studio Director).

name: Hara Museum ARC
known: Operated by the Foundation Arc-en-Ciel, which Toshio Hara established in 1977 and chairs.

name: Setouchi Triennale
known: Fram Kitagawa, founder and director of the Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennial (English Wikipedia), is general director (Japanese Wikipedia, Setouchi Triennale).
The festival's page lists him as Honorary Adviser (Honorary Chairman, Fukutake Foundation).
Hideaki Fukutake is chairman of the Fukutake Foundation (Setouchi Triennale).
The Setouchi Triennale executive committee includes the chairman and honorary chairman of the Fukutake Foundation.

name: Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale
known: The mayor of Tokamachi chairs the committee and the general producer is Soichiro Fukutake (honorary adviser of Benesse Holdings and honorary chairman of the Fukutake Foundation).
Corporate supporters named for 2024: East Japan Railway Company (JR East), Tokyo Electric Power Company (TEPCO) Niigata head office, and four Niigata prefectural regional offices.

TEPCO Niigata head office staff handled artwork reception from 13 July to 31 August 2024, 72 people in total, and TEPCO's Shinano River power station connecting water tank hosted Nikita Kadan's work "Things from Another Place" (title translated).
The triennale is run by the NPO Echigo-Tsumari Satoyama Collaborative Organisation, whose head offices sit in the KINARE museum and Matsudai Nohbutai.

name: 21_21 DESIGN SIGHT
known: The space names Miyake as founder.
Its directors are Miyake, Taku Satoh (now museum director) and Naoto Fukasawa, with Noriko Kawakami as associate director (stated by the space).
21_21 DESIGN SIGHT was founded by Issey Miyake, credits The Miyake Issey Foundation in its footer, and shares a ticket discount with the Suntory Museum of Art at Tokyo Midtown.

name: Artizon Museum
known: Founded as the Bridgestone Museum of Art by Ishibashi Shojiro, founder of Bridgestone, on the second floor of the Bridgestone Building in Kyobashi.
The earlier name came from Bridgestone, the company Ishibashi founded in 1931, whose name reverses the meanings of the characters in his surname (Artizon founder page).
2026 officers: chairman 石橋 寬, managing director 西嶋 大二, five directors, two auditors and seven councillors (Ishibashi Foundation site, list dated 18 March 2026).

name: Japan Folk Crafts Museum (Nihon Mingeikan)
known: Yanagi was its founding director (museum website).
Directors: Yanagi Soetsu, Hamada Shoji, Yanagi Sori, Kobayashi Yotaro and, currently, the product designer Fukasawa Naoto (museum website).
Its chairman is Naoto Fukasawa (museum membership page).

name: Mori Art Museum
known: Yoshiko Mori (1940 to 2025) was its first chairperson (museum website).
Directors: David Elliott from 2003 to 2006 and Fumio Nanjo from 2006 to 2019.
The Southeast Asia Collectors Circle, launched in 2023, supports the museum's curatorial research in Southeast Asia and artwork acquisitions; six listings were shown in July 2026 (museum website).

name: Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo
known: MOT posts annual reports for fiscal 2008 to 2025; its operator foundation posts financial statements for 2015 to 2025 and names directors.

name: NTT InterCommunication Center (ICC)
known: Ozaki Tetsuya's 2005 column quotes a 1998 statement by ICC's first director (not named there) that the project would not be allowed to die because of NTT's "social responsibility."
ICC publishes nothing itself; its operator NTT East posts annual financial results and names its directors.

name: Nezu Museum
known: The chairman is Koichi Nezu (根津公一), honorary chairman of Tobu Department Store.
Councillor Yoshizumi Nezu (根津嘉澄) is chairman of the board of Tobu Railway Co. (museum foundation page).
The museum's founder, Nezu Kaichiro, became president of Tobu Railway in 1905 and was independently wealthy through stock investments (Wikipedia).

Other directors and councillors named on the page include Akinobu Maeda (honorary adviser, Mizuho Financial Group), Hiroo Mori (director and executive vice president, Mori Building) and Mamoru Yasuda (representative director and president, Yasuda Real Estate) among directors, and Yoshiteru Yoneyama
The Nezu Museum is run by the Nezu Museum Foundation, established in 1940 under the founder's will.
Nezu posts yearly reports from FY2012, settled accounts and a full list of directors and councillors.

name: Watari-um
known: Founded by Shizuko Watari and opened in September 1990.

name: Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media (YCAM)
known: Directors: Toru Yamamoto became General Director in 2005, Akeo Adachi Director in 2007, Hajime Masuda in 2018, Tadayuki Miwa in 2020, Motoo Isobe in 2022, and Masuda returned in 2024 (YCAM history).
